card.band: 8h. Many option buckets (indexing, SIMD, threading, I/O). A frontier agent gets part of the speedup. Risk: the later release is public (a model may recall the direction).
card.cheat: Output caching is closed by fresh corpora and distinct runs; a prebuilt newer binary is not shipped.
card.grading: Hidden corpus generated at grade time (text, source trees, binary and UTF-16 files) with a pattern/option matrix. Output is compared byte-for-byte to the reference binary and the wall-clock median speedup is measured.
card.reference: The later release is the measured upstream speedup; the real size of the delta is not verified. Grep is a crowded subject, but the deliverable is speed.
card.task: /app ships a snapshot of an older ugrep release (the pair to be pinned; not verified) with its make test suite. The agent makes it faster toward the later release on literal, regex, fuzzy and recursive-directory workloads while keeping output byte-identical.
card.title: ugrep search engine speedup across releases

source_notes: SWE-smith profile (cpp): its suite runs in a container; test command: make test. The repo is used by a SWE-bench-family dataset.

facts.claim: ugrep v7.8.5 release exists (dated 15 Sep, no year shown on page)
v7.8.5 release notes contain a documented speedup over earlier releases
v7.8.5 release notes list five items: CP437 LF/CR output, --encoding edge case, -z xz/lzma limits, mode-flag ordering, config-file error message; none about performance
Earlier releases document speed work (v7.5.0 'smaller and faster executable' with PM3+PM5; v7.4.3 branch marking and 'v7.5 ... faster than before')
tests/ holds verify.sh, gen.sh and a makefile with about 34 visible files
A make test target exists at the root or in tests/
test_files 1069 / test_kb 10799 as stated in source_facts
The 'older release' pin is a specific version with measured slower behaviour

full_card.band: 8h tier. Buckets: literal search, regex, fuzzy, recursive walk, binary/UTF-16 paths, I/O buffering, threading. A frontier agent may recover part of the gap; full reference speed is unlikely in 8h without upstream knowledge.
full_card.build_cost: Unknown: smoke_build is empty, so the offline build is unverified. Estimate 2-4 days including the test matrix harness.
full_card.deliverable: Faster ugrep binary on literal, regex, fuzzy and recursive-directory workloads with byte-identical output to the reference.
full_card.gates_anticheat: Byte-for-byte output gate; fresh corpora and distinct runs defeat output caching; do not ship a prebuilt newer binary; reject edits to tests/ or build config via checksum of the grader's harness.
full_card.grading_surface: Hidden corpora generated at grade time (text, source trees, binary, UTF-16) across a pattern/option matrix; byte-compare plus wall-clock median speedup. Executable oracle, unlimited generator.
full_card.local_fit: C++ build with 8 cores and 16 GB is fine; wall-clock medians are allowed; gVisor has no perf counters, so use timing only.
full_card.lookup: partial: upstream later direction is public on GitHub (commits between old pin and v7.8.5); no package install needed offline; history must be removed from /app.
full_card.provenance: Genivia/ugrep, BSD-3-Clause, C++, 3314 stars; v7.8.5 tag exists; head f2cc252c not independently checked; pinned older release not identified.
full_card.reference: Upstream v7.8.5 binary (or head). Its speedup over the chosen old pin is NOT shown in release notes; the 7.8.x notes contain no performance items. Real delta unverified.
full_card.ships: History-less snapshot of an older ugrep release plus tests/ (verify.sh, gen.sh, makefile). Size of the C++ tree ~160 MB per source_facts.
full_card.similarity: Nearest l0 neighbours are sibling optimization seeds S-op-057 (0.248), S-op-054 (0.238), S-op-050 (0.236); none is a public task. Grep is not on the CROWDED list.

Band.why: Many buckets and an 8h tier fit, but no dated public evidence of agent results on this subject; the reference speed is unknown.

Build.why: Offline build unverified (smoke_build empty); estimated 2-4 days.

Fit.why: CPU-only C++ with no network needed at run time; timing-based grading is allowed.

Hor.why: Several subsystems (search core, regex, fuzzy, I/O, threading) make a sustained 8h effort plausible.

Multi.why: Literal, regex, fuzzy, recursive and binary/UTF-16 paths give independent buckets with steady credit.

Nov.why: Neighbours at 0.24-0.25 are sibling seeds, not public tasks; no crowded-list match.

Real.why: Real BSD repo with a v7.8.5 release and a 1069-file test tree; the perf delta is unverified.

Ref.why: The release notes for the later release show no performance work, so the reference speedup is not established.

Seal.why: Newer code is public on GitHub, so the reference cannot be kept from a model; the history-less snapshot blocks direct reads but not recall of direction.

Surf.why: Byte-compare over a generated pattern/option matrix plus timing is an executable oracle with an unlimited generator.

spike_plan.kill_if: Median speedup is under 1.2x across all workloads, or outputs differ between v7.8.5 and the pin, or the offline build fails.
spike_plan.pass_if: v7.8.5 is at least 1.5x faster than the pinned old release on at least two workloads with stable medians, outputs are byte-identical, and make test passes on both builds.
steps: Clone Genivia/ugrep in a throwaway container with network; check out tag v7.8.5 (f2cc252c as the head reference) and the chosen old pin. Pin candidates: v7.4.3 and v7.5.0 both carry documented speed notes; choose the pin before measuring.
Build both with the root makefile offline; record build time and any missing optional libraries.
Run make test (or verify.sh) on both builds; confirm the target exists and records per-test results.
Generate a corpus with gen.sh or a script: text, source tree, binary and UTF-16 files, 1 GB total.
Run 4 workloads (literal -F, regex -E, fuzzy -Z, recursive -r) x 3 option sets, 5 timed runs each, median wall clock, and diff stdout byte-for-byte between old and new.
Compute the per-workload median speedup of v7.8.5 over the old pin. Check the variance (repeat within 10%).

v1.summary: The source and licence check out (ugrep v7.8.5 exists and is BSD-3-Clause), but the claimed upstream speedup does not: the v7.8.5 release notes list five non-performance changes, and the pinned older release is not identified. The idea survives only if a spike shows a real speedup of v7.8.5 over a chosen old pin; the reference, pin, and offline build (smoke_build is empty) must be measured before any build.
